observations: Three photos show a smartphone held in hand against a wooden background.
The phone has a large, curved screen with a centered punch-hole camera at the top.
The screen displays a purple-themed home screen with standard Android apps: Play Store, Google, Chrome, Camera, etc.
The time shown is 6:24, with Wi-Fi and battery icons visible.
The phone has a slim bezel and a metallic or glass frame with a visible side button.
No physical S Pen slot is visible on the side in photo 1.
No brand or model name is visible on the front or side in any photo.
The seller claims it is 'Direct uk used in pristine condition' and that 'the pen doesn't work'.

claims.claim: Direct uk used in pristine condition
claims.evidence: No proof of origin or condition beyond the screen being on; no visible damage, but no inspection of back, ports, or internals.

claims.claim: the pen doesn't work (faulty pen I guess)
claims.evidence: No S Pen is visible in any photo, and no photo shows the pen or its slot. The phone's design suggests it may be a Samsung Galaxy Note or S series with S Pen support, but this is not confirmed.

risks.risk: The phone may not be a premium model as implied by the 'pristine condition' and 'Direct uk' claim; it could be a lower-end or counterfeit device.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the back of the phone showing the brand logo and model name, or a screenshot of the Settings > About phone.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic used smartphone without brand/model premium

risks.risk: The S Pen is missing or non-functional, which may affect value if the buyer expects it to work.
risks.proof: A photo of the S Pen and its slot, or a video showing the pen being inserted and used.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a phone without S Pen functionality

risks.risk: The phone may have hidden damage, water damage, or software issues not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the phone being turned off, powered on, and used for calls, camera, and apps, including a full inspection of the back and ports.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a used phone with unknown condition

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the phone showing the brand and model.
Photo or video of the S Pen and its slot, or confirmation that it is not included.
Video showing the phone being powered off and on, and used for calls and camera.
Screenshot of Settings > About phone to confirm model and software version.
response.reason: The phone's brand and model cannot be identified from the photos, and the seller's claims about origin and S Pen functionality are unverified. Without proof of identity and condition, a reliable price cannot be assigned.
